emoji.picker.button.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the icon button in the corner of the post's text that opens the emoji picker.

emoji.picker.title.description: Accessible name of the popover of the emoji picker (Unicode emoji and the server's custom emoji).

emoji.picker.search.description: Label of the search field of the emoji picker; it finds emoji by name, keyword, shortcode or other name.

emoji.picker.grid.description: Accessible name of the grid of emoji in the emoji picker.

emoji.picker.loading.description: What the emoji picker tells assistive technology while its emoji load, the first time it opens.

emoji.picker.load_failed.defaultMessage: Die Emoji konnten nicht geladen werden. Schließe die Auswahl und öffne sie erneut, um es noch einmal zu versuchen.
emoji.picker.load_failed.description: What the emoji picker says above its grid when the Unicode emoji could not be loaded; the server's custom emoji are still offered.

emoji.picker.frequent.description: Heading of the emoji used most often and most lately on this device, first in the picker.

emoji.picker.uncategorized.description: Heading of the custom emoji without a category in the picker.

emoji.picker.empty.description: What the emoji picker shows when nothing matches the search.

emoji.picker.categories.description: Accessible name of the row of icon buttons above the emoji grid of the picker; each button scrolls to one section (frequently used, a category).

emoji.picker.results.description: Heading of the one section of emoji that match the search in the emoji picker.

emoji.picker.result_count.defaultMessage: {count, plural, =0 {Keine Emoji gefunden} one {# Emoji gefunden} other {# Emoji gefunden}}
emoji.picker.result_count.description: Read out by screen readers once typing in the search field of the emoji picker pauses: the number of emoji that match.

emoji.picker.group.smileys_emotion.description: Heading of the section of the Unicode emoji group Smileys & Emotion (faces, hearts) in the emoji picker, also the name of its button.

emoji.picker.group.people_body.description: Heading of the section of the Unicode emoji group People & Body (hands, people, jobs) in the emoji picker, also the name of its button.

emoji.picker.group.animals_nature.description: Heading of the section of the Unicode emoji group Animals & Nature in the emoji picker, also the name of its button.

emoji.picker.group.food_drink.description: Heading of the section of the Unicode emoji group Food & Drink in the emoji picker, also the name of its button.

emoji.picker.group.travel_places.description: Heading of the section of the Unicode emoji group Travel & Places (vehicles, buildings, weather) in the emoji picker, also the name of its button.

emoji.picker.group.activities.description: Heading of the section of the Unicode emoji group Activities (sports, games, events) in the emoji picker, also the name of its button.

emoji.picker.group.objects.description: Heading of the section of the Unicode emoji group Objects in the emoji picker, also the name of its button.

emoji.picker.group.symbols.description: Heading of the section of the Unicode emoji group Symbols in the emoji picker, also the name of its button.

emoji.picker.group.flags.description: Heading of the section of the Unicode emoji group Flags in the emoji picker, also the name of its button.

emoji.picker.skin_tone.description: Accessible name and tooltip of the button beside the search field of the emoji picker that opens the menu of skin tones, and the name of that menu.

emoji.picker.skin_tone.none.description: The default (yellow) skin tone in the skin tone menu of the emoji picker.

emoji.picker.skin_tone.light.description: A skin tone in the skin tone menu of the emoji picker: the CLDR name of the modifier U+1F3FB.

emoji.picker.skin_tone.medium_light.description: A skin tone in the skin tone menu of the emoji picker: the CLDR name of the modifier U+1F3FC.

emoji.picker.skin_tone.medium.description: A skin tone in the skin tone menu of the emoji picker: the CLDR name of the modifier U+1F3FD.

emoji.picker.skin_tone.medium_dark.description: A skin tone in the skin tone menu of the emoji picker: the CLDR name of the modifier U+1F3FE.

emoji.picker.skin_tone.dark.description: A skin tone in the skin tone menu of the emoji picker: the CLDR name of the modifier U+1F3FF.
